brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc cap pricing (market fair-value at volume) and pay in 15 days to free up ₹2.39 L cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap (or similar items) at higher volume or looser spec.
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, and the market verdict says there's modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec — so we're targeting the fair end of the band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 days.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Freeing up ₹2.39 L cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj Blow Plast publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means we build our case from what we do know: the open market says ₹0.65–0.80/pc is fair at volume, and we have four strong second-source candidates (Manjushree, Mold-Tek, Hitech, Pearl) plus six manufacturer/recycler leads to qualify. With no public numbers to lean on, our leverage is the credible threat of moving volume elsewhere and the carrot of faster payment.

evidence.point: We spend ₹58.17 L a year with them — material volume to move if we qualify an alternate.
Market asking price for the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
Market verdict: MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec.
HDPE resin import price is 87.61 ₹/kg — a public benchmark for raw-material cost movement.
Paying them in 15 days instead of 30 frees up ₹2.39 L cash for us.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already flagged for packaging.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed, ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma packaging — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (manufacturer, India-Pan)
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India manufacturer of rigid plastics, medium confidence.

risks: Suraj Blow Plast's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their cash position and stability — watch for any signs of stress (late deliveries, quality dips) that might mean trouble.

We have no internal price benchmark (no best-price-we-pay data) — we're relying entirely on the open-market ask; if our specs are tighter or volumes lower than market reference, ₹0.65–0.80 may not stick.
The market backups (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, Chemco, etc.) are leads, not qualified sources — don't threaten to switch to them unless we've audited and priced at least one.

If we push too hard on price and payment together without a qualified second source live, Suraj may call our bluff — sequence the asks: price first, then payment as a sweetener once we have an alternate nearly ready.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about aligning your 28 mm cap pricing to the ₹0.65–0.80 band we're seeing in the market at volume, and in return we can look at paying you faster — say 15 days instead of 30.
